resources.string: This backup was made with a newer version of Memory Map. Update the app, then restore it again.

After the restore, Memory Map links your memories to the photos and videos on this phone. Choose \"Allow all\" so it can find all of them.\n\nIf you select only some photos, or don\'t allow access, the restore still works, and you can allow more access afterwards to link the rest.

With the current access, Memory Map couldn\'t find every photo and video of your memories. Allow access to all photos and videos to link the rest. You can also do this later with \"Re-link Gallery Photos\".
The backup \'%1$s\' will be permanently deleted from Google Drive. This cannot be undone.

Editing this memory replaces the memory you started on the Add tab.

Memory Map uses your location to show where you are on the map and to pick it for a memory. It\'s only used while the app is open.
To show where you are, allow location access for Memory Map in Settings.
Your location isn\'t available right now. Check that location is turned on.
